station: mortar (cooking station #8) or hand-mix 2 herbs, 3 with Mortar_Iron
rules: Each herb carries 2 essences. Mixing 2-3 herbs pools essences; the strongest matching pair (by summed potency) picks the effect.
Recipes are hidden. A new effect is logged to the player's Herbal journal on first discovery (saved in save/schema quests-like 'discoveries').
No matching pair: 'Murky Brew' (no effect, 50% chance of -5 hunger). Dried herbs give +1 potency, fresh give +50% duration.
Potency sum scales duration: dur * (0.5 + 0.25*sum). Triple mixes can stack two effects if two different pairs match.
Same 3 herbs + 'purify' essence = no side effects.

Forge Temper (Hephaestus): after brewing, quench path modifies the effect — magma temper strength x2 duration x0.5; spring quench duration x2 strength x0.5; dual-quench (magma then spring or reverse within 10s) applies dual effect (primary pair + next-best pair at base). See data/islands/hephaestus/herbs.json.
